node: Hidden customer/supplier dependency mapping across consumer brands, retailers, and niche suppliers
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around hidden consumer customer/supplier dependencies. The strongest underfollowed mapping is not a brand screen but a filing-mining screen: identify suppliers or infrastructure vendors whose revenue, workflows, or operational switching costs are tied to Walmart, Home Depot, Lowe's, Costco, Amazon, Target, and other high-volume retail channels. This pass keeps one mega-cap retailer as a reference anchor and prioritizes smaller/mid-cap discovery candidates where filings expose customer concentration or retail-network dependency.
